what_it_does: Online payments, billing, invoicing and financial infrastructure platform.
auth_notes: Secret (sk_), restricted (rk_), publishable (pk_) and organization (sk_org_) keys sent as Bearer; restricted keys can be tagged as agent keys with approval rules. OAuth available for MCP and Connect/Stripe Apps. Stripe MCP stops accepting full secret keys and non-agent restricted keys from Jan 11, 2027.
access_notes: Sandboxes with sk_test_/rk_test_ keys are available from the Dashboard on signup; live mode needs account activation for real payments.
api_notes: Full REST API (v1 + v2) covering payments, customers, billing, invoices, Connect, Issuing, Treasury, Tax, Radar, webhooks.

what_it_does: Connects apps to users' bank accounts for transactions, auth, identity, payments.
auth_notes: client_id + secret in body or PLAID-CLIENT-ID / PLAID-SECRET headers; per-user access_token obtained via Plaid Link (public_token exchange). Dashboard MCP uses Plaid Dashboard login.
access_notes: Sandbox is free with unlimited mock Items. Trial plan (US/Canada signups since Apr 15 2026) is free, auto-approved for most, real data, up to 10 Production Items. Full Production is paid and requires approval (company + use-case info, a couple of business days). Some products (e.g. EU/UK Payment Initiation) need special enablement even in Sandbox.
api_notes: Auth, Balance, Identity, Transactions, Investments, Liabilities, Transfer, Identity Verification, Monitor, Assets, Income, Statements, Link, Items, processor tokens.
main_blocker: production approval for real data at scale
human_needed: submit Production access request in Plaid Dashboard (beyond Sandbox/Trial)

evidence.mcp: https://plaid.com/en-eu/blog/plaid-mcp-ai-assistant-claude/ (Dashboard MCP); also local Sandbox MCP mcp-server-plaid per https://www.developersdigest.tech/mcp-servers/plaid-sandbox

what_it_does: Cryptocurrency exchange for spot, margin, futures trading and wallets.
auth_notes: X-MBX-APIKEY header plus signed timestamp; HMAC, RSA (PKCS#8) or Ed25519 keys (Ed25519 recommended). Unrestricted-IP HMAC keys are read-only; trading must be enabled per key. Official MCP uses a consent-screen authorization instead of local keys.
access_notes: No fee, but creating API keys requires 2FA, a deposit of any amount to Spot Wallet, and 'Verified Plus' identity verification (KYC). Product availability depends on region/account status; geo-restriction list not verified this pass. Official MCP account actions require creating and manually funding an Agentic sub-account.
api_notes: Spot REST + WebSocket API + streams; security types NONE (market data), TRADE, USER_DATA, USER_STREAM; plus margin, futures, wallet product APIs.
main_blocker: KYC'd (Verified Plus) funded account; regional restrictions
human_needed: complete Binance KYC, enable 2FA, deposit funds, create API key with IP restriction

what_it_does: Forensic FX audit detecting hidden bank markups on cross-border payments.
auth_notes: MCP tools check_fx_rate, audit_transaction, compare_fx_sources need no auth (audit limited to 3/month per IP); full_forensic_report requires a Bearer token/API key. How to obtain the key not documented in sources found.
access_notes: Free tools are unauthenticated; paid per-report tool needs credential (price not listed). Operated by 11850091 Canada Inc. (iPayX Protocol), FINTRAC MSB registered. ipayx.ai/docs could not be opened (not reachable from this session), so no first-party API docs were verified. Name collides with Internet Payment Exchange Inc. (ipayx.com, acquired by BillingTree 2017) and an unrelated testnet USDC invoicing demo (ipayx.vercel.app).
api_notes: Only an MCP endpoint (streamable HTTP) with 3-4 tools found; no REST reference verified.
main_blocker: no documented public REST API; only small MCP surface
human_needed: obtain API key for paid report tool

what_it_does: Small-business accounting: invoices, bills, payments, reports.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow via an app on Intuit Developer; refresh tokens rotate. Production requires public HTTPS redirect URIs (localhost only in sandbox).
access_notes: Free developer account gives sandbox companies. Intuit App Partner Program: Builder tier $0 with 500,000 CorePlus (data-out/GET) credits/month, blocked beyond; Core (data-in) calls unlimited; paid tiers Silver $300 / Gold $1,700 / Platinum $4,500 per month (third-party source). Production-key requirements (app assessment/questionnaire) not verified this pass - Intuit docs pages render client-side and could not be read.
api_notes: QuickBooks Online Accounting API: ~29+ entities (customers, invoices, bills, payments, items, accounts, journal entries) plus reports; also Payments, Payroll APIs.
main_blocker: metered CorePlus read calls; production key review (unverified)
human_needed: complete production key steps in Intuit Developer portal
